Survey_Information.Title: Food Processing Firm Performance and Foreign Direct Investment Survey
Survey_Information.Purpose: To examine the influence of FDI on food processing firm performance in Lagos, Nigeria
Survey_Information.Target_Respondents: Senior managers, CEOs, and operations heads of food processing firms
Survey_Information.Confidentiality: All responses are confidential and will be used for academic research only

Section_A.Title: Company Background Information
Section_A.Instructions: Please provide basic information about your company

Q1.Question: What is your company's name?
Q1.Note: This will be kept confidential and used only for identification

Q2.Question: How many employees does your company currently have?

Q3.Question: What is your company's approximate annual revenue?

Q4.Question: How many years has your company been in operation?

Q5.Question: Which food processing subsector best describes your company?

Q6.Question: What is your company's ownership structure?

Section_B.Title: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Information
Section_B.Instructions: Please answer questions about foreign direct investment in your company

Q7.Question: Does your company have any foreign direct investment?
Q7.Note: FDI includes foreign ownership, joint ventures, or strategic partnerships with foreign companies

Q8.Question: If yes, what percentage of your company is foreign-owned?

Q9.Question: How many years has your company had foreign investment?

Q10.Question: What type of foreign investment does your company have?
Options: Greenfield Investment (New facility built by foreign company)
Merger & Acquisition (Foreign company acquired your company)
Strategic Alliance (Cooperation agreement with foreign company)

Q11.Question: Which region/country is your foreign investor from?

Section_C.Title: FDI Impact Assessment (Likert Scale 1-5)
Section_C.Instructions: Please rate the following statements about the impact of foreign investment on your company. 1 = Strongly Disagree, 2 = Disagree, 3 = Neutral, 4 = Agree, 5 = Strongly Agree

Q12.Question: Foreign investment has improved our ability to absorb new knowledge and technology

Q13.Question: Foreign investment has enhanced our task performance and operational efficiency

Q14.Question: Foreign investment has increased our innovation capabilities and new product development

Q15.Question: Foreign investment has provided access to better financial resources and capital

Section_D.Title: Firm Performance Indicators
Section_D.Instructions: Please provide information about your company's performance (approximate figures are acceptable)

Q16.Question: What is your company's approximate Return on Investment (ROI) for the last financial year?

Q17.Question: What is your company's approximate Return on Assets (ROA) for the last financial year?

Q18.Question: What percentage of your revenue comes from exports?

Q19.Question: What is your company's approximate market share in your main product category?

Q20.Question: How would you rate your company's operational efficiency?

Q21.Question: What was your company's revenue growth rate last year?

Section_E.Title: Firm Resources and Capabilities
Section_E.Instructions: Please provide information about your company's resources and capabilities

Q22.Question: What percentage of your workforce consists of skilled workers (university graduates, technicians, etc.)?

Q23.Question: Does your company use Internet of Things (IoT) technologies in production?

Q24.Question: What percentage of your revenue do you invest in Research and Development?

Q25.Question: How would you rate your company's technology adoption level?

Q26.Question: What is your company's current ratio (current assets/current liabilities)?

Q27.Question: What percentage of your revenue do you invest in employee training?

Section_F.Title: Government Policy Assessment (Likert Scale 1-7)
Section_F.Instructions: Please rate the following aspects of government policy affecting your business. 1 = Very Poor, 7 = Excellent

Q28.Question: How effective are government tax incentives for your industry?

Q29.Question: How stable are government regulations affecting your business?

Q30.Question: How adequate is government infrastructure support (roads, power, water)?

Q31.Question: How would you rate your experience with corruption in government dealings?

Q32.Question: Overall, how effective are government policies for your business?

Q33.Question: How would you rate the ease of doing business in Nigeria?

Q34.Question: How accessible are government support programs for your company?

Q35.Question: How burdensome are government regulatory requirements?

Section_G.Title: Additional Information
Section_G.Instructions: Please provide any additional relevant information

Q37.Question: Does your company have ISO certification?

Q38.Question: Does your company have HACCP certification?

Q39.Question: In which area of Lagos is your company located?

Q40.Question: How many years has your company been involved in exports?

Q41.Question: How would you rate your company's supply chain integration?

Q42.Question: How would you rate the intensity of competition in your market?

Consent_Form.Title: Informed Consent Form
Consent_Form.Content:
I understand that:
                1. This survey is part of academic research on foreign direct investment in food processing firms
                2. My participation is voluntary and I can withdraw at any time
                3. All information provided will be kept confidential and used only for research purposes
                4. No individual company will be identified in any published results
                5. The data will be stored securely and destroyed after the research is completed
                6. I can request a summary of the research findings when available
                
                By completing this survey, I consent to participate in this research study.
